 News › Learning News › Meet Vipin Dev Yadav: Watchman’s son who secured AIR 316 in UPSC 2025, helped 15+ students Meet Vipin Dev Yadav: Watchman’s son who secured AIR 316 in UPSC 2025, helped 15+ students
 Sajid Raza Published: Oct 23, 2026, 19:24 IST Updated: Oct 23, 2026, 19:24 IST UPSC Success Story: Watchman’s Son Vipin Dev Yadav Secures AIR 316 in UPSC 2025 The UPSC success story of Vipin Dev Yadav is an inspiring example of how hard work, determination and family support can help overcome financial difficulties. Vipin hailed from Ambedkar Nagar, Uttar Pradesh where his family was poor.
 He is a member of the police station and his father is a watchman at the police station while his mother is a homemaker.
 But amidst monetary problems and social pressure, Vipin persevered with his dream of becoming an officer. His hard work was rewarded during UPSC Civil Services Examination 2025 when he got the All India Rank (AIR) 316 position. 
 But his success goes beyond just the UPSC exam. Vipin also contributed to the welfare of the underprivileged children by offering free coaching in Lucknow. 
 As per the account of his journey, over 15 students who he taught, were selected in the UPPSC 2024 examination.
 Vipin Dev Yadav’s family background and early struggles
 Vipin Dev Yadav is from a small village in Ambedkar Nagar, Uttar Pradesh. His father is a policeman who is working in a police station as a watchman and his mother is working as a housekeeper. His family were hard up, but his parents and brother were able to support his studies and his aspirations.
 Vipin's preparation for the Civil Services Examination of UPSC is a huge sacrifice from his family. 
 The family reportedly defrauded their mother's fixed deposit (FD) and obtained a loan using the Kisan Credit Card (KCC) facility to prepare for the test.
 With this financial support, Vipin moved to Delhi to prepare for the civil services examination. His family’s trust in him became an important source of motivation throughout his preparation.
 Left expensive coaching, chose self-study and overcame repeated failures
 After moving to Delhi to prepare for the UPSC Civil Services Examination, Vipin Dev Yadav realised that expensive coaching classes were not meeting his expectations. 
 He decided to change his approach rather than continue spending money on coaching institutes. He left coaching and shifted his focus to self-study, using libraries, study materials and digital resources to prepare for the examination.
 Vipin started making his own preparation strategy according to his needs and understanding of the UPSC syllabus. He concentrated on the study, the revision of topics of importance and the identification of the topics that needed improvement. 
 His choice also allowed him to cut costs on costly coaching centers.
 However, his journey towards becoming a civil servant was far from easy. Vipin had some failures in preparing for UPSC and Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC). He finally made it to the interview rounds several times but failed to get into the short-list then.
 All these letdowns made preparation difficult and coupled with criticism and taunts from people around him. 
 However, he never gave up his dream of becoming an officer, and instead worked towards his goal.
 Vipin also looked at his preparation strategy following the failures. He studied what went wrong and re-thought his choice of optional subject for better results in his retakes. Instead of repeating the same process over and over, he sought to learn from what he needed to modify in his preparation.
 This experience demonstrates the need to learn from failure in exams. 
 To succeed in the UPSC selection process, regular self-assessment is crucial and the question of consistency plays a significant role while trying to crack both the Preliminary Examination and Main Examination and Personality Test.
 Vipin had been diligently working towards his goal and had overcome numerous obstacles before achieving success in the UPSC CSE 2025.Vipin had been preparing himself for years and had faced many challenges before finally achieving All India Rank (AIR) 316 in the UPSC Civil Services Examination 2025. 
 The accomplishment was a milestone in his life and his family's lives who had sacrificed their finances to pursue his dreams.
 Vipin's journey proves that aspirants can venture into the various preparation options depending on their situation. His resolve to do self-study, learn from failures and persist with his efforts to achieve the dream of becoming an UPSC officer played a crucial role in his success.
 UPSC 2025 result: Vipin Dev Yadav secures AIR 316
 After years of hard work, Vipin finally achieved his old dream and passed the UPSC Civil Services Examination (CSE) 2025. He secured All India Rank 316 , marking a major milestone in his journey towards becoming a civil servant.
 His accomplishment was the realization of a long-held dream of his family. The sacrifices that his parents made and the assistance he received from his brother became a key element to his success.
 For aspiring civil servants from economically weaker backgrounds, Vipin’s journey highlights the value of persistence and careful preparation. His experience also demonstrates why candidates need to identify their weaknesses, adapt their strategies and continue learning throughout the examination process.
 Vipin Dev Yadav provides free coaching to more than 15 students
 Vipin also worked to assist financially challenged students, plus worked on preparing for the Civil Services examination.
 In preparing for his role, he was said to have started teaching the unprivileged at Bhagidari Bhawan in Lucknow without any fee. He was well aware of the hardships of preparing for competitive examinations with limited resources, and knew how hard it was for students who could not afford coaching.
 It is reported that he helped more than 15 students to get selected for the UPPSC 2024 exam.
 This is a significant achievement of Vipin's story. In his struggle to achieve his own dream of becoming a government officer, he also helped other aspirants make strides towards achieving their dreams.
 Lessons from Vipin Dev Yadav’s UPSC success story
 Vipin Dev Yadav’s UPSC journey offers several lessons for students preparing for competitive examinations:
 Financial difficulties do not have to end a dream: Limited resources can make preparation difficult, but aspirants can explore affordable study materials, libraries and digital resources.
 Self-study can be an alternative to expensive coaching: A structured timetable, regular revision and consistent practice can help candidates prepare independently.
 Failures can guide improvement: Analysing mistakes and changing an ineffective strategy can help aspirants improve their performance.
 Family support matters: Encouragement and sacrifices from family members can provide motivation during difficult periods.
 Helping others creates a wider impact: Vipin’s free coaching initiative shows how knowledge and guidance can support students who lack access to expensive educational resources.
 Vipin Dev Yadav’s success story is not only about securing AIR 316 in UPSC 2025. It is also about overcoming financial hardship, learning from repeated setbacks and helping other students pursue their ambitions. His journey offers encouragement to civil services aspirants who continue to work towards their goals despite limited resources and difficult circumstances.
